text_simplified: The text discusses the importance of raising children upon Islamic values and noble akhlaq, with a focus on the necessity of teaching them patience and endurance. It also highlights the role of parents in instilling these values through good example (uswah hasanah) and continuous guidance.

review_defects.english: The Importance of Akhlaq Tarbiyah for Children
review_defects.why: The Arabic title uses a plain, everyday phrase 'التربية الأخلاقية' (moral education/upbringing). The English title replaces it with transliterated Islamic jargon 'Akhlaq Tarbiyah', which is not a standard compound and makes the title less accessible and more preachy than the original.
